name: model-confirmation-gate
cmd:
set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; set +e; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.model-confirmation.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/types.log" 2>&1; T=$?; bun test --timeout 120000 kernel/model-confirmation.test.ts kernel/model-sequence.test.ts kernel/model-values.test.ts research/bapa/candidate-seed.test.ts research/bapa/existential-seed.test.ts research/bapa/native-ghost-public.test.ts research/bapa/sum-seed.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; U=$?; GDP_EPR=0 GDP_SET_FIRST=0 bun test --timeout 120000 research/bapa/model-confirmation-public.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/public.log" 2>&1; P=$?; printf 'types=%s tests=%s public=%s
' "$T" "$U" "$P" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/checks.txt"; bun test --timeout 120000 $(find ./kernel -maxdepth 1 -name '*.test.ts' | sort) > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/kernel.log" 2>&1; K=$?; bun research/bapa/model-confirmation-mutation.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/mutation.log" 2>&1; M=$?; printf 'kernel=%s mutation=%s
' "$K" "$M" >> "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/checks.txt"; GDP_STRICT=0 GDP_EPR=0 GDP_SET_FIRST=0 bun test --timeout 120000 research/bapa/model-confirmation-public.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/strict-zero.log" 2>&1; S=$?; printf '%s
' 'fix(prove): reject unconfirmed model verdicts' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1; L=$?; printf 'strictZero=%s lint=%s
' "$S" "$L" >> "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/checks.txt"; test "$T$U$P$K$M$S$L" = 0000000
